thread:
Anna: :rotating_light: PagerBot alert - spike in 5xx on /v1/generate (us-west). Noticing customer timeouts, some streaming sessions drop.
PagerBot: INCIDENT #7592 triggered by rate of 5xx > 1.5% sustained for 3m — severity: P2. Pager sent to on-call rota.
Anna: I'm primary but out for a doctor's appt at 23:10 UTC, back ~00:45 UTC. Need someone to shadow/cover 23:10-00:45 UTC. Holiday weekend, fewer folks online.
Devon: I can jump in as shadow but stuck on a train until 23:40 UTC. Can do 23:40-01:00 UTC if that helps.
Samir: I can take 23:10-23:50 UTC as interim shadow. Will be remote and reachable. :thumbsup:
Anna: Perfect. So plan: Samir picks up 23:10-23:50, Devon takes 23:40-01:00 (overlap 10m). Maria, can you backfill 00:45-02:00 in case I run late?
Maria: I can cover 00:45-02:15 UTC. On-call calendar updated.
Leo: Quick note — customers A and C reported streaming truncation; error pattern shows worker OOMs on model-x-quant. I'm running a targeted rollback to model-x-int8 variant now.
OpsBot: Executing rollback job model-x-quant -> model-x-int8 on pool gw-us-west-4. Job ID: job_2026_03_15_88. ETA ~4m.
Anna: Runbook link: https://redwood.runbooks/incident/streaming-5xx. Follow Section 2 (rollback) then Section 4 (traffic drain). Keep logs from affected pods.
Samir: Applying runbook step 2.3 - draining pod group gw-worker-12. Command:
```
kubectl annotate pod gw-worker-12 redwood/drain=true && kubectl cordon gw-worker-12
```
Samir: Logs show repeated allocation failure around heap growth + spike at token 256.
Devon: I can monitor error budget and adjust scaling. Increasing replica count by +2 on the pool in the short term.
Leo: Scaling applied: `k8s autoscale set gw-us-west-4 --replicas 6` — monitoring latency.
PagerBot: Event: rollback job completed successfully. Error rate dipped to 0.6% in the last 2m.
Anna: Good progress. Customer impact: ~120 unique users experienced streaming interruptions over last 15m; no sustained data loss. Notifying CS to draft banner just in case.
Maria: CS pinged, they suggested a message for affected tenants; waiting on final wording.
Devon: Observability shows 95th latency down from 1200ms -> 430ms after scaling and rollback.
Samir: I'll stay on for 15 more minutes and then hand over formally to Devon. Reminder to update the incident channel with timeline before handing off.
Anna: Formal handoff procedure: update incident doc, annotate what was changed (rollback/scaling/drain), confirm mitigation success for 10m, then release primary. Use `ops-handbook/hand-off` template.
Leo: Also tag the deploy that rolled back: `deploy/model-x-int8@2026-03-15-88` in the incident doc.
Devon: I'm taking primary at 00:00 UTC. Samir, if you can confirm stable for 10m by 00:05, I'll take over. Maria will remain secondary.
Samir: Confirmed: stable 10m monitoring window passed at 23:55 UTC. Error rate holding ~0.4%.
Anna: Thanks everyone. After handoff, please add any follow-up actions (postmortem eyeballs, model quantization review) to the incident JIRA.
Maria: Adding: "verify model-x quant memory profile, add automatic fallback to model-x-int8 when OOMs detected" to actions.
Devon: On it. Will also verify the on-call rota for the holiday window — we may need to expand shadow coverage for the rest of the day.
Anna: Closing notes: no customer escalations opened yet; CS drafting advisory. If anything spikes above 1% again, re-trigger paging and escalate to P1.
PagerBot: Incident #7592 status -> mitigated (P2). Monitoring continues.
Anna: :wave: handoff complete. Devon is primary now, Maria secondary. Samir, thanks for the quick fill. I'll update the calendar post-visit.
Devon: thumbs. Logging final checks and setting a 15m follow-up reminder. `remind me in 15m to recheck incident 7592`
Maria: I'll stay on watch until 02:15 UTC. Good catch team. :eyes:
